## Activity

Oakridge Primary Care recorded 35 captures during May 2021. Activity was completed at the site as part of routine primary care operations. The volume of captures provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes for the month. Records should continue to be maintained in line with local operating arrangements so that any changes in activity can be identified and followed up.

## Image quality

There was 1 ungradable capture, giving an ungradable rate of 2.9 per cent. This indicates that most captures were suitable for assessment, while the ungradable result should be reviewed through the usual quality assurance process. The clinic lead asks that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk. Logging these issues will support monitoring, help identify repeated equipment or process problems, and inform any action required at the site.

## Grading

A total of 6 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 1 day. These results should be considered alongside the activity and image quality measures to support routine service monitoring. Any required follow-up should be managed through established clinical and operational arrangements.
